lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Heya, Commander {AccountData.NickName}!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: I'm here for something urgent. Do you have a minute to spare?
Sure, I'm free.
Sorry, no can do.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Woohoo! I'm glad I came!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Oh, come now! Don't be like that!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: But I've alrdy checked your schedule tho.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: So listen to what I have to say.
Sure, I guess?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: All right, do you know Volume? Nvm, I'm sure you do.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: She's the greatest rapper in the entire Ark, but she can be quite the handful.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Someone like her would benefit from having a manager.
Does she not have one?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: She did, but they quit.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Finding a new manager has proven... rather difficult.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Volume's schedule is filling up, and she still doesn't have a manager! The situation is critical!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: So I beg of you, please be Volume's manager.
You think I can do it?
I can't do it.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Sure, you'll do great!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: You won't have to do much.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Just help Volume manage what she has left on her schedule.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Why not?!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Volume is a real hellraiser when she's up on stage.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: You two have a lot in common, so I figured you'd be up for it.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: I'm not saying it'll be easy, but I'm sure you can do it.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Just help Volume manage what she has left on her schedule.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: You're my last hope! Please!
... Where is Volume?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: According to her schedule, she should be at the concert hall.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: I can't thank you enough!
Yeah, yeah.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Enterrrrrrrrrtainment!
